news.h: NFL Week 11 latest intel, buzz questions, news, fantasy tips: What we're hearing
news.d: What are people around the league saying about Fernando Mendoza? Could changes be coming in Dallas? And what now for New England? Here's the latest intel.

news.h: Behind Raiders fans' tribute to Fernando Mendoza's mother
news.d: Tom Joanides' social media campaign became a meaningful tribute when Mendoza scored in his first NFL start.

news.h: Concerns for four NFL teams on playoff bubble: Cowboys, Raiders, Texans, Patriots
news.d: The Cowboys' defense got lit up, the Patriots lost Drake Maye, the Raiders are adjusting to Fernando Mendoza, and the Texans can't find support for C.J. Stroud.

news.h: Raiders' Fernando Mendoza vows to learn from first NFL start, a loss to Seahawks
news.d: Fernando Mendoza completed 17 of 29 passes for 143 yards and had a passer rating of 71.5 in his first regular-season start for the Raiders.

news.h: Seahawks beat Raiders 21-13 as Drew Lock throws for 2 TDs and Seattle sacks Fernando Mendoza 6 times
news.d: — The lead-up to Sunday's Seattle-Las Vegas matchup was almost all about Fernando Mendoza, at last receiving his first start as the Raiders' quarterback.
